using Printf

function main()
    month_names = [
        "January",
        "February",
        "March",
        "April",
        "May",
        "June",
        "July",
        "August",
        "September",
        "October",
        "November",
        "December",
    ]
    for (index, (year, month)) in enumerate([(2024, 2), (2026, 8), (2026, 11)])
        index > 1 && println()
        println(month_names[month], " ", year)
        println("Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa")
        adjusted_year = month < 3 ? year-1 : year
        adjusted_month = month < 3 ? month+12 : month
        century, within = divrem(adjusted_year, 100)
        weekday = mod(
            1+div(13*(adjusted_month+1), 5)+within+div(within, 4)+div(century, 4)+5*century+6,
            7,
        )
        leap = year%4 == 0 && (year%100 != 0 || year%400 == 0)
        days =
            month == 2 && leap ? 29 :
            [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31][month]
        fields = fill("  ", weekday)
        for day = 1:days
            push!(fields, @sprintf("%2d", day))
            if length(fields) == 7 || day == days
                println(join(fields, " "))
                empty!(fields)
            end
        end
    end
end

main()
